warm_start_policy: All 10 arms branch from the single shared support-only warm-start checkpoint with verified SHA-256.

decision_gates.joint_beats_scalar: Joint proposer must outperform common-scalar proposer on independent query under equal compute.
decision_gates.dice_guard_beats_smaller_lr: Hard-Dice guarded adaptation must outperform smaller learning rate baseline under equal compute.
decision_gates.u_beats_extra_supervised: Unlabeled adaptation must outperform extra supervised training on observed support under equal compute.
decision_gates.no_software_only_go: Software-only, synthetic, or missing patient evaluations strictly yield NO_GO / NOT_RUN, never software GO.

scalar_brier.description: Common scalar proposer alpha = s * 1 preserving cross terms, Brier finite predicate

joint_brier.description: Joint multi-direction proposer, Brier finite predicate

scalar_dice.description: Common scalar proposer alpha = s * 1, dual Brier + hard-Dice finite predicate

joint_dice.description: Joint multi-direction proposer, dual Brier + hard-Dice finite predicate on full support volume

frozen.description: Frozen head control with 0 parameter updates

support_only.description: Support-only supervised warm-start reference without unlabeled adaptation

plain_head_u.description: Unguarded head adaptation with unlabeled pseudo-labels

extra_supervised.description: Extra support-supervised training matching adaptation compute budget to test U utility

smaller_lr.description: Tuned smaller pseudo learning rate baseline on development protocol

full_ema.description: Full model EMA continuation updating backbone/decoder at matched compute
